verdicts.reason: The two candidates are nearly identical and share the same faults. The Quillbrook logo is blown up into a huge disc that runs off the top-left edge and is now the main focal point instead of the headline. The dark header band is left as an orphan slab in the top-right corner, and the orange divider floats far off to the right with nothing near it. The 'Reserve a Case' CTA is tiny and buried at the bottom left, jammed beside the unreadable legal text and 'Ships late June'. B's logo is a little larger and more cropped on the left edge, and its body copy runs closer to the edges, so A is marginally less bad.
